parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description or remarks for the GDN.

parameters.name: DestinationRegion
parameters.description: The region of the destination PolarFS instance.

parameters.name: DestinationType
parameters.description:
The type of the destination instance. Valid values:

- **pfs**: PolarFS High-Performance Edition.

- **pcs**: PolarFS Cold Storage Edition.

parameters.name: FreezeSourceDuringSync
parameters.description:
Whether to freeze the source path during transmission. Valid values:

- **true**: Freeze.

- **false**: Do not freeze.

> Currently only supports oss source.

parameters.name: SourceRegion
parameters.description: The region of the source PolarFS instance.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the source instance. Valid values:

- **pfs**: PolarFS High-Performance Edition.

- **pcs**: PolarFS Cold Storage Edition.
